To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new model of gene expression in polycistronic mRNAs is proposed based on mRNA secondary structures, and that the model is supported by the experimental data.

the translation of the genes for the heat‐labile and cholera toxins of E. coli is regulated by the formation of stable local secondary structures in the polycistronic mRNA, which interferes with the movement of ribosomes on the mRNA and consequently decreases the translation rate.
the translation of the genes of Escherichiacoli heat‐labile and cholera toxin is controlled by mRNA secondary structures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism of translational control in the polycystronic mRNA of E. coli heat‐labine toxin and cholera toxine.
the regulation of expression of the heat‐labile enterotoxin operon (LT) and the cholera toxin (CTX) operon of Escherichiacoli, and the mechanism of their translation in vivo.
the mechanism of translational regulation of the polycistrons in the operons of heat‐labile and cholera toxin, which have a similar structure.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single mechanism that controls the expression of LT and cholera toxin genes.
the LT mRNA secondary structures have a regulatory function in translation.
the LT and cholera toxin operons are under translational control.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mRNA secondary structure is an important factor in the translational control of the LT and cholera toxin operons.
the mRNA secondary structure is the most important factor for controlling translation of the toxin genes.
the LT operon has a more efficient translational regulation mechanism than that of the cholera toxin operon, which may be the cause of their different biological properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the secondary structures of mRNA are important for gene regulation.
the mRNA secondary structure plays a critical role in regulating gene expression.
the mRNA secondary structure is a key factor in the regulation of the translation rate.
